title: Junior Selection Committee Minutes Released by BAI
indian_angle: These minutes detail the decisions and discussions regarding the selection of India's junior badminton talent for upcoming events.
summary: The Badminton Association of India published the minutes from its latest Junior Selection Committee meeting, outlining key decisions for young players.

title: BAI Establishes New Athletes Committee
indian_angle: The formation of the BAI Athletes Committee provides a direct voice for Indian badminton players in governance and decision-making.
summary: The Badminton Association of India officially announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee on October 2nd, aiming to enhance player representation.

title: National Coaching Camp for World Junior Championships 2026 Begins in Guwahati
indian_angle: India's top junior badminton players are currently training at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati in preparation for the BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: A national coaching camp for Indian junior shuttlers preparing for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026 has commenced at the NCE in Guwahati.

title: BAI Level-1 Advanced Coaches Course Held in Guwahati & Raipur
indian_angle: This advanced coaching course benefits Indian badminton by upskilling domestic coaches, which directly impacts player development across the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India conducted a Level-1 (Advanced) Coaches Course at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati and Raipur from September 14th to 23rd.

title: BAI Implements 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
indian_angle: The new 3x15 scoring system in domestic junior tournaments will significantly impact how young Indian players train and compete, potentially influencing future international performance.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced the implementation of a 3x15 scoring system for U-13, U-15, and U-17 domestic ranking tournaments and national championships.
